question: If 782 is divided in the ratio of (1)/(2) : (2)/(3) : (3)/(4) , then the first part will be:
solution:
Given:

782 is divided in the ratio of (1)/(2) : (2)/(3) : (3)/(4) 

Calculation:

782 is divided in the ratio of 

⇒ (1)/(2) : (2)/(3) : (3)/(4) 

⇒ (1)/(2) × 12 : (2)/(3) × 12 : (3)/(4) × 12

⇒ 6 : 8 : 9

Now, the first part = 782 × 6/(6 + 8 + 9)

⇒ 782 × 6/23 = 204

∴ The first part is 204.
